video.fallback_strategy: WebM first for Firefox/Linux codec fallback; MP4 retained for Safari and H.264-native browsers.

start_screen.title: 1.1 - What Good Footage Shows
start_screen.description: The video pauses at key coaching moments. Read each explanation, then continue playback.

interactions.title: Mid-corner oversteer
interactions.description: Mid-corner oversteer forces the driver to correct the steering away from the corner. This opens the kart's line and causes the driver to miss the apex.

interactions.title: Rear steps out again
interactions.description: The driver loses the rear again. Listen for the slight lift as the throttle cuts out. This time, the driver recovers and still hits the apex successfully.
